blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Two-time Grand Slam champion Barbora Krejcikova was the latest player to withdraw from the Singapore Open. Krejcikova dropped out of the WTA 500 tournament on Wednesday just before her round-of-16 match against defending champion Elise Mertens at OCBC Arena Center Court. READ: Alex Eala vs Tatiana Prozorova in Singapore Open round of 16 Krejcikova dropped out due to a lower back injury, according to the WTA. The 30-year-old Czech outlasted German qualifier Anna-Lena Friedsam, 6-0, 7-5, 7-6(4), on Tuesday. Krejcikova, the former World No. 2, won the 2021 French Open and 2024 Wimbledon.
